G1.name: AXI4-Lite & AXI4-Stream protocol compliance
G1.description: All mapped/unmapped AXI4-Lite registers (0x000..0x144), split AW/W, WSTRB, BREADY/RREADY stalls, SLVERR, aresetn *ready gating, and AXI4-Stream syndrome ingress bit-packing behave per spec.

G2.name: Deterministic cycle law & fast-loop budget
G2.description: Exact L_core(K) = 2+5K (4+5K in Mode 2) and L_axis(K) = 7+5K (9+5K in Mode 2), <= 300 ns fast-loop compliance across K=1..5 and OSD_MODE=0..2, (corr_x, corr_z) packing, and 1-cycle epoch_irq.

G3.name: Non-blocking ingress tap & pipeline isolation
G3.description: End-to-end axis_ingress_tap -> axis_syndrome_rx -> bp_engine -> axis_correction_tx flow; dma_tap_stall_in=1 increments dma_tap_drop_count_mon and sticky overflow_warn with zero fast-path stall.

G4.name: Atomic triple-buffered weight-bank & epoch safety
G4.description: Shadow-to-snapshot-to-active isolation, bp_ready_in-gated 1-cycle swap, mid-decode COMMIT deferral (STATUS=0x3), busy-lock SLVERR against torn shadow writes, and monotonic epoch_count.

G5.name: Elastic FIFO backpressure, reset recovery & stress
G5.description: Power-on reset defaults, synchronous mid-decode aresetn recovery across all BP states, m_axis_correction_tready=0 stability, 16-entry RX FIFO full/drain lossless semantics, and 10,000-syndrome stress.

G6.name: Q7.8 Min-Sum, OSD-0 & GF(2) mathematical equivalence
G6.description: Zero mismatches across exhaustive 3,840-state (K=1..5 x Mode=0..2 x 256 syndromes) Vaa_qec_top vs golden Q7.8 sweeps, inhomogeneous wx != wz degenerate tie-breaking, and H_X/H_Z GF(2) parity satisfaction.

G7.name: Formal SVA verification & hardware synthesis constraints
G7.description: Live Verilator --assert satisfaction of bound sva_weight_commit_assertions.sv + embedded SVAs, negative fault-injection SVA firing proof, active 4.000 ns aa_qec.xdc clock, and zero-DSP resource/YAML parity.

G8.name: Deterministic replay, clean provenance & STA disclosure
G8.description: Bit-for-bit deterministic replay across resets/seeds, VCD/CSV/SHA-256 RTL provenance persistence, 200/200 canonical ID execution, code_git_dirty == false, and explicit Vivado STA boundary disclosure.

fidelity_disclaimers.rtl_simulation_scope: Native Verilator 5.048 (--assert --trace) compiles the actual synthesizable SystemVerilog hierarchy (aa_qec_top, axis_ingress_tap, axis_syndrome_rx, weight_map_reg, bp_engine, check_node_minsum, axis_correction_tx, plus bound sva_weight_commit_assertions) into cycle-accurate 2-state C++ logic, proving exact synchronous FSM cycle laws, AMBA AXI4-Lite/AXI4-Stream handshakes, Q7.8 arithmetic, and formal SVA invariants at a nominal 4.000 ns (250.0 MHz) simulation clock.
fidelity_disclaimers.vivado_sta_scope: Cycle-accurate Verilator RTL simulation does NOT perform gate-level netlist synthesis, FPGA placement and routing, wire-delay back-annotation, or post-route Static Timing Analysis (WNS/TNS). Physical 250.0 MHz timing closure on Xilinx Zynq-7020 (xc7z020clg484-1) or UltraScale+ ZCU104/K26 requires Vivado synthesis and post-route STA against firmware/constraints/aa_qec.xdc.
